I need to decide whether to sell houses or declare bankruptcy to cover a $50 debt.

I have no mortgagable properties. I can sell houses on ST_CHARLES_PLACE, STATES_AVENUE, and VIRGINIA_AVENUE to raise the $20 shortfall. Each house is worth $50.

I am calculating the exact cash impact of selling one house. The owed amount is 50, but the shortfall is only 20. I am unsure if this represents one payment or multiple payments.

Selling one house would raise $50 and leave $30 cash after the $50 payment. I must also follow Monopoly's even-building rule, which may prevent selling just one house.

Selling one house is allowed under the even-building rule. I am weighing which pink property to sell based on rent values.

Dropping one house from a property would slash its rent from $450 to $150. This removes the main threat on that street. I have no choice but to sell or declare bankruptcy.

Bankruptcy would hand my pink monopoly to p2, who already controls dark blues and reds. I must sell the minimum houses instead. The engine may ask for another $50 from me later.

The $50 owed to p2 is only the first payment. The card requires paying both remaining players, so I may need to sell two houses for a total of $100. I am calculating whether to prepare for that larger shortfall now.

I will sell exactly one house now to cover the $20 shortfall. I am choosing which pink property to downgrade from three houses to two, weighing which rent drop is least costly.

I am mapping the board positions. p4 is at St. James Place, which sits past the pink properties. This means p4 is unlikely to land on my houses immediately. I am using this positioning to decide which house to sell.

p4 has already passed the pink properties safely. p2 is at Reading Railroad, far from them. Neither opponent is immediately threatening my houses this turn. I am resolving my own Chance card now.

I will sell one house from St. Charles Place. Virginia Avenue would lose $320 in rent, while St. Charles and States each lose $300.

St. Charles Place is one space from Jail, making it a frequent landing spot after release. I am weighing whether to keep it at three houses rather than sell one.

I calculated the exact probabilities of landing on each pink property after exiting Jail. Virginia Avenue is the most likely landing spot from Jail, so I will keep it at three houses. St. Charles Place is the least likely, so I will sell one house from there.
